baseline_policy: unchanged PR46/48; execute room fusion only when strict inputs are complete
existing_source_odometry: verify and reuse PR46 T10 output; do not repeat the same replay
exploration_policy: no numeric exploration without a defensible physical base origin, actual initialization and sampling-clock convention; no zero/default substitutions

video_review.method: PyAV sequential decode in memory; select existing observation frames by integer PTS; overlay PR49 corners without re-detection
video_review.output: one reduced contact sheet, CSV/JSON; never all 4K frames

reference_policy: keep not_accepted unless new independent spatial/time evidence resolves prerequisites; qualitative pixel-stage observations may be reported separately
